channel.title: Smithsonian / USGS Weekly Volcanic Activity Report
channel.description: Constructed fixture in the shape of the GVP RSS; the live feed was unreachable (403) when this was written.

item.title: Etna (Italy) - New Activity/Unrest
item.description: INGV reported that Strombolian activity at the SE Crater resumed on 12 October & lava fountaining fed a flow toward the Valle del Bove.

item.title: Great Sitkin (United States) - Ongoing Activity
item.description: AVO reported that slow lava effusion continued in the summit crater. The Volcano Alert Level remained at Watch and the Aviation Color Code at Orange.
